_note: Machine-readable language ownership policy. Authoritative source for validate_language_ownership.py. Human-readable mirror: AI_ENTRY.md section 1 (fixed ownership rules + language map). Every Python file is classified by directory path → domain → required language. Files in Rust-owned domains implemented in Python require explicit retention entry or must migrate.
_ordering_note: Rules are evaluated FIRST-MATCH in array order. Specific paths (ai/, provider/, adaptive/) MUST precede their general parent rules. Do not reorder without updating the validator.

rules.description: AI engineering, intent, plan, sandbox, ML interfaces. Always Python per AI_ENTRY.md §1.
rules.python_glue_scope: ALL - AI/ML is Python-owned per AI_ENTRY.md §1

ALL — strategy logic is Python-owned per AI_ENTRY.md §1
